data.name: Super Starship
data.detailed_description:
Super Starship is a space simulation in a universe with one million stars and 18 million planets and moons. The game is all about exploration and discovery and not combat. Your ship has no weapons. Your mission is to discover new worlds, claim ownership of stars and worlds and explore deep space.



Explore a Galaxy of One Million Stars. Uncover the Mysteries of a Lost Civilization.

MASSIVE SCALE EXPLORATION

  • 1 Million Stars with unique procedurally generated solar systems

  • Over 18 Million Worlds to explore

  • 200,000+ Starbases scattered across the galaxy

  • Persistent Shared Universe - your discoveries are permanent and visible to all players

  • True scale universe - stars really are light years apart from each other

Multi-Vehicle Exploration

  • Starship: Pilot your starship between star systems and down to planet surfaces

  • Planetary Rover: Deploy your rover to explore planetary surfaces and mine for minerals

  • Seamless Transitions from interstellar flight to surface exploration

THE ANCIENT MYSTERY

Millions of years ago, an advanced alien race achieved technological transcendence that ultimately led to their extinction in a single catastrophic night. Now their legacy haunts the galaxy in the form of:

  • Universal Pod Network: Mysterious resource caches seeded across every world

  • Ancient Structures: Dormant alien installations that respond to worthy explorers

  • Consciousness Archives: Ancient sites where alien minds still persist

Progressive Story Revelation

  • Discovery Journals: Unlock the complete record of humanity's first contact with this lost race

  • Evolving Technology: Alien pods and structures become more responsive as you prove your worth

  • 70+ Lore Entries: Research archives, military reports, AI perspectives, and modern exporer testimonies

DEEP EXPLORATION MECHANICS

Advanced Discovery Systems

  • Multi-Tier Scanning: Planet, star system, sector and quadrant

  • Secret Star Network: 350+ hidden easter eggs with cultural and scientific significance

  • Beacon Hunting: Discover rare technology and discovery beacons hidden across the galaxy

Meaningful Progression

  • Ship Upgrades: Enhance speed, fuel capacity, life support, and exploration equipment

  • Technology Unlocks: Advanced mining lasers, beacon detectors, scanning probes, and more

  • Discovery Statistics: Track your exploration achievements across multiple categories

  • Community Recognition: First discoverer attribution for all celestial bodies

COMPREHENSIVE SHIP COMPUTER

Navigation & Information Hub

  • Galaxy Map: Visual representation of your discoveries and exploration progress

  • Course Plotting: Plot routes to any of the million stars with distance and fuel calculations

  • System Analysis: Detailed breakdowns of planets, moons, gas giants, and discoveries

  • Starbase Locator: Find the nearest trading posts and upgrade facilities

  • Mission Browser: Accept exploration contracts and track your progress

Economic & Trading Systems

  • Dynamic Markets: 200,000+ starbases with varying exchange rates

  • Resource Management: Mine minerals, collect alien artifacts, trade habitable planet data

  • Upgrade Economy: Invest credits in ship improvements and exploration equipment

  • Discovery Rewards: Substantial bonuses for finding rare phenomena and secret locations

COMMUNITY & SHARING

Shared Discovery Database

  • Real-Time Synchronization: All discoveries shared with the global community

  • Discoverer Attribution: See who first found each star, planet, and moon

  • Exploration Statistics: Track community progress across the entire galaxy

  • Discovery Racing: Compete to solve galactic missions across the galaxy

Social Exploration Features

  • Explorer Rankings: Leaderboards for various discovery categories

TECHNICAL EXCELLENCE

Cutting-Edge Performance

  • Threaded Galaxy Scanning: Smooth FPS while scanning a million stars

  • Efficient Data Management: Persistent universe state

  • Dynamic LOD Systems: Seamless transitions from galaxy view to surface detail

  • Cloud Synchronization: Your progress and discoveries saved across all sessions

  • Unique Worlds: Gas giants, ocean worlds, rocky worlds, atmospheres and clouds

Realistic Mechanics

  • Multi-Scale Speed Control: From light-year-per-second travel to precise surface navigation

  • Fuel Management: Strategic resource planning for long-distance exploration

  • Life Support Systems: Recharge your life support at nearby starbases

PLAY YOUR WAY

Multiple Exploration Styles

  • Deep Space Pioneer: Focus on discovering new star systems and worlds

  • Archaeological Explorer: Investigate alien sites and uncover ancient mysteries

  • Resource Hunter: Master the economic game through mining and trading

  • Mission Specialist: Complete exploration contracts and build your reputation

Endless Replayability

  • Procedural Content: Every star system is unique with infinite exploration potential

  • Progressive Unlocks: New story content and mechanics based on your discovery count

KEY FEATURES

✅ 1 Million Star Galaxy - True scale and more than 400 light years across

✅ Persistent Shared Universe - Your discoveries matter and are permanent

✅ Rich Alien Storyline - Uncover the mystery of an extinct transcendent civilization

✅ Multi-Vehicle Exploration - Starships, rovers, and seamless transitions

✅ Advanced Ship Computer - Comprehensive navigation and analysis tools

✅ Dynamic Economy - 200,000+ trading posts with upgrade systems

✅ Community Discovery - Real-time sharing with global explorer network

✅ Progressive Revelation - Story unfolds based on your exploration achievements

✅ Secret Star Network - 350+ hidden locations with special significance

data.short_description: A futuristic sci-fi persistent universe exploration game with one million stars and 18 million planets and moons. Fly your ship to any star and explore its solar system. Claiming stars, planets and moons will make them yours forever - other players will see your discoveries and you will see theirs.
